market_view: Calm VIX (14.4, falling), 10-year yield near highs at 4.72%, dollar firm; gold fell 2.9% on Friday and semis fell 3.5%. Monday opens with fresh US-Iran strikes lifting oil and hawkish Warsh commentary.

oil_gas.catalyst: none qualifying: 'Energy stocks rally as fresh U.S.-Iran attacks drive oil prices higher' (Yahoo) is a driver move of about +2% premarket; the Chevron Venezuela deal is CVX-specific, not XOM.
oil_gas.reasoning: The oil bounce reverses a de-escalation drop and is already in premarket prices; the Iran story has flipped direction repeatedly. XOM news is only a STEM investment item. No one-sided XOM catalyst.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold -2.9% on a rising 10-year yield and firmer dollar, with Warsh hawkishness the new headline. NEM is still up 37% in 20 days. The only NEM-tagged headline is a junior explorer's drilling update. No NEM guidance news.

chips.catalyst: none: the NVDA earnings result and guidance are not in the record; only 'Nvidia's $3.5 Billion MediaTek Deal Revives the Circular Financing Debate' (Benzinga), which is commentary.
chips.reasoning: NVDA fell 4.6% Friday in a semis -3.5% day; AVGO earnings this week add two-sided variance. The headlines are bubble and financing commentary plus a JPMorgan preview. No one-sided setup.

pharma.catalyst: weak: 'Eli Lilly Says 52-Week Data from TOGETHER-PsO and TOGETHER-PsA Phase 3b trials ... Taltz and Zepbound' (Benzinga) is a positive combination-use readout on existing drugs.
pharma.reasoning: The data are a modest label-extension signal, not a new approval or pricing change, and likely small for LLY value. The stock is off 6% in 5 days, but that is not a reason by itself. The 'Eli Lilly' midday mover item has no content.

copper_uranium.reasoning: No FCX, copper or uranium headlines. FCX is up 22% in 20 days; the uranium ETF fell 5.8% Friday. Copper is near a record and priced. No FCX guidance news.

would_change_my_mind: An FCX guidance raise or copper supply outage, an XOM-specific supply or M&A item, NEM production guidance, a strong NVDA guidance reaction in the next record, or an LLY approval or pricing deal.

handoff.what_changed: Fresh US-Iran strikes lifted oil about 2% premarket, reversing last week's de-escalation drop. Gold fell 2.9% on Friday with the 10-year yield at 4.72% and hawkish Warsh talk. Chips fell 3.5% Friday; the NVDA earnings reaction is still not visible. LLY posted positive Taltz plus Zepbound phase 3b data.

oil_gas.why: The oil jump is a priced driver move and XOM news is minor; the Chevron Venezuela deal is CVX only.

gold_miners.why: Rate and dollar headwinds and NEM extended after +37% in 20 days; no NEM-specific catalyst.

chips.why: No NVDA-specific catalyst; AVGO earnings this week are a two-sided event.

pharma.why: The LLY combination-data headline is modest and not a one-sided catalyst.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX guidance or supply news; the copper record is priced.
